interpretation: In this sequential same-bench run, essentially all observed sub-millisecond RTT variation co-varies approximately one-for-one with responder RX-IRQ-to-handler latency. The remaining measured phases are nearly constant by comparison. This localizes the timing variation to the responder scheduling/loop interval, but does not by itself prove that delay(1) is the sole underlying cause.
scientific_boundary: The correlation is descriptive for one sequential fixed-PHY run and the samples are not independent. The diagnostic residual is not propagation delay. A mirrored run with COM4 initiator / COM3 responder should be collected before changing timing firmware.
